title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1982-08-07
lineage: Master Cassette -> Nakamichi Dragon -> HHB CDR830 Plus -> EAC -> CDWave -> FLAC
source: 2 Sony ECM-23F microphones (90 degrees, coincident)-> Sony TC-D5M -> 2 Maxell XLII-S 90 Cassettes w/ Dolby B (20th row, center, 8ft stand)

ai_review.summary: Good audience tape capturing a solid August ’82 performance with standout Althea, Let It Grow and a flawless Playin' → Morning Dew transition.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its classic late‑summer ’82 vibe, tight set flow and highlights such as Althea, the China>Rider sandwich, Playin’ into Wheel and a superb Let It Grow. Reviewers note clear Phil bass levels, energetic Jerry/Brent interplay and furious drumming, though the audience recording suffers from dated noise‑reduction artifacts and occasional low‑end distortion.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the performance 4‑5 stars while noting some recording flaws; weighting show quality (70%) and recording quality (30%) yields a combined rating around 3.8.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear audience tape with good levels in set 2, Phil’s bass is distinct and Brent’s keys shine; however noise‑reduction of the era adds hiss and some low‑end distortion, making it less pristine than a soundboard source.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Nice flow with a strong opening trio, smooth transitions—especially Playin' Reprise into Morning Dew—and an effective closing sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great jamming with Brent during 'Playin'' and solid lead throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass sounds clearer; levels are set right at the start of set 2.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards stand out, especially in the space sections and during the Playin' sandwich.
band_member_comments.Drums: Furious drumming that drives the energy of the second set.
